text:
Sam: Heads-up — Nimbus (Enterprise) flagged by the health watcher. Usage down ~62% over last 7d, key seats inactive, renewal in 24 days. I’m starting a micro-save flow. Short plan: touchpoint, enablement pairing, temporary credits trial, downgrade guardrails if they insist. ⚠️
Maria: Thanks — can you drop the quick health snapshot? I’ll take lead on the enablement pairing and run the checklist.
cs-bot: Account health snapshot for Nimbus — last_active: 2026-03-12, weekly_api_calls: 38k (was 100k), top_feature: streaming-inference, alerts: low-engagement, renewal_date: 2026-04-05.
Sam: Copying paste of the quick notes I pulled from console: `last_successful_onboard_step: model-pinning`, `avg_response_time_users: +20%`, `recent_errors: cache-miss-rate spike`.
AJ: Quick Q — have they reached out to support this month? I see 1 ticket about model aliasing two weeks ago, resolved. No other high-priority tickets.
Maria: Ok. Proposed cadence: Day 0 (today): intro + health email + calendar for 15-min scoping call. Day 2: enablement pairing (screen share, 45m) with our Solutions Engineer. Day 4: apply targeted promo (1-week free reserved capacity credits) if they commit to the enablement session. Day 7: checkback; if no engagement, open downgrade-safety conversation and offer phased downgrade with data-preserving export.
Liam: +1 to the phased downgrade offer. Add rollback SLA and a migration checklist so they don’t fear data loss. Also prepare a summary for the AE to discuss commercial tradeoffs.
Sam: Draft email I plan to send (feel free to edit):
```
Hi Team Nimbus — Sam from Redwood CS here. We noticed a drop in usage and wanted to check in before your renewal on Apr 5. Can we schedule a 15-min sync this week to review obstacles and share a short enablement session tailored to your integration? We can offer a temporary credits package and a clear downgrade/migration plan if needed.\nBest,\nSam
```
Maria: Nice. Add a one-click calendar link and a short agenda: 1) quick health summary, 2) pain points, 3) next steps (enablement / credits / downgrade path).
AJ: I’ll prepare the support log export and paste the key error lines into the play notes. Also flagging that infra team had a maintenance window 3/10 that may have impacted batch jobs.
cs-bot: Playbook template attached: `micro-save-v2` (actions: email-template, enablement-pairing, apply-credits, downgrade-offer).
Sam: Action assignments: Maria -> run the pairing session (SE: @Liam), AJ -> support log + infra context, Sam -> outreach + AE sync, Liam -> migration checklist + rollback SLA draft.
Maria: For the enablement pairing, goal is hands-on: reproduce integration trace, confirm KV cache behavior, enable prefix caching suggestions. If we can show a 20% latency improvement in-session, they usually re-engage.
Liam: I’ll prep a short demo: checklist items (1) reproduce failing flow, (2) enable prefix caching snippet, (3) quantization tradeoffs doc link, (4) export path for model checkpoints. Snippet I’ll share in session:
```
# Prefix caching snippet (pseudo)
cache.prefetch(prefix, max_age=3600)
if cache.hit(): reuse.kv_cache()
else: continue.normal()
```
Maria: If they decline the enablement session, escalate to an AE call and lead with a usage-based credit instead of a full discount. Keep renewal motion positive.
Sam: Timeline check — I’ll send the outreach now. If they don’t pick a slot by Day 2, we fire the auto-nudge sequence (in-product modal + email) and apply the 1-week credits on Day 4 without waiting.
AJ: Noted. I’ll also attach the resolved ticket thread and infra maintenance notes to the thread for transparency.
Maria: Post-session success criteria: 1) commit to 2-week pilot usage (measured by API calls), OR 2) AE-approved downgrade with migration dates set. If neither, escalate to manager review and consider an executive check-in.
Sam: Logging this as the official micro-save flow for Nimbus. Will paste call notes and the session recording into the CS playbook after the enablement.
Liam: One more — prepare a short one-pager for their CTO showing unit economics: cost before vs after suggested optimizations (batching + cache + quantization). That usually helps procurement sign-off.
Maria: Great. I’ll mark status as `in-progress` in our CS tracker. Will update thread after the pairing session. :thumbsup:
